task.name: Strike_common_yurt
task.when: During Strike after every person and belonging leaves the common yurt

step.action: Confirm that no person or personal belonging remains inside the yurt.
Have the Power Lead de-energize, disconnect, and remove the yurt air conditioner and cables.
Put clean, dry communal soft items in their assigned clear storage bags.
Collapse and pack the yurt shell in the manufacturer's printed sequence.
step.ifThen: IF wind prevents control of a wall or roof section, THEN secure the material and stop.

step.action: Remove every anchor and ground fastener.
Clean, dry, fold, and pack the ground covering.
Put every yurt fastener and anchor in its assigned hardware bin.

passWhen.criterion: The air conditioner and cables are de-energized, removed, and packed.
The yurt shell, soft items, ground covering, fasteners, and anchors are accounted for and packed.
The former yurt footprint is clear and MOOP-free.
